name: OMG-Bench
description: Online micro gesture recognition from hand skeletons is critical for VR/AR interaction but faces challenges due to limited public datasets and task-specific algorithms. Micro gestures involve subtle motion patterns, which make constructing datasets with precise skeletons and frame-level annotations difficult. To this end, we develop a multi-view self-supervised pipeline to automatically generate skeleton data, complemented by heuristic rules and expert refinement for semi-automatic annotation. Based on this pipeline, we introduce OMG-Bench, the first large-scale public benchmark for skeleton-based online micro gesture recognition. It features 40 fine-grained gesture classes with 13,948 instances across 1,272 sequences, characterized by subtle motions, rapid dynamics, and continuous execution. reputation: A newly introduced large-scale benchmark for skeleton-based online micro-gesture recognition, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: Vision/HCI benchmark with fine-grained, subtle temporal gestures; likely non-LLM and early-stage, so reported scores may not be directly comparable across protocols.
